description: This file defines the BookingRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository to perform database operations related to Booking entities. It includes custom methods to find bookings by driver and vehicle.

classes.name: BookingRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for Booking entities, providing methods to find bookings by driver and vehicle.

methods.name: findByDriver
methods.description: Returns a list of bookings associated with a specific driver (User).

methods.name: findByVehicle
methods.description: Returns a list of bookings associated with a specific vehicle.
